title: Women Employability Initiatives
summary: Enable economic independence for women from underserved communities through skill building and income generation.
description: Saksham Trust, in partnership with Sakha Ek Pahal, Noida, empowers women by providing training in crochet craft and other handicrafts, coupled with access to markets and enterprise support. This intervention allows women to create high-quality handmade products that generate sustainable income, enhancing both household resilience and community dignity. Beyond livelihood creation, the programme has also extended impact to animal welfare, with women supporting the care of stray dogs in need. The initiative aligns national priorities on rural livelihoods and women’s economic empowerment.
